name: Key la box
source:
Introduction:

Bringing “I’m home” and “Welcome back” into your everyday life.

The days you spend together don’t need to be filled with extraordinary events. Yet there are moments of laughter, moments of missed steps, moments when the heart wavers. As those small moments quietly accumulate, the “key to the heart” slowly begins to turn.

Gentle, joyful, and at times bittersweet. Within the shared life where sweetness and pain intertwine, what the two of them discover is—their true feelings, hidden deep inside a box.

Key la box—a love story that unlocks the heart.

Story:

The one who pried open my heart was a boy with magical hands. Street art on a university campus. By chance, a girl passing by found herself frozen in place, as if under a spell. At the end of her gaze was a boy, happily painting.

Then, some time later... Her mother, who had remained single ever since her father passed away, decided to remarry. On the day they met, the person who appeared before the girl was that very same boy.

“You’ll be living together from now on.”

As she said this, she handed them a key—the key to the apartment where the two of them would live. And so, life under the same roof with him,who had suddenly become family, begins.

This is a story where love mends, and love lays bare—a tale woven around the key to the heart.

[Translated from the [url=https://lamina-pla.net/Keylabox/story.html]official website[/url]]
